verdict.rationale: Notion's API, webhooks, and internal/public connections let an engineer build custom scripts or integrations against the workspace, but the evidence pack shows only event-driven triggers (webhooks) and manual API scripting — no native cron/schedule-based trigger or built-in recurring-workflow scheduler is documented. An engineer could combine the API with external cron/Workers to approximate this, but that requires outside tooling.  missing for 10: a documented native scheduling/cron trigger inside Notion (e.g., 'run this automation every Monday'), evidence of built-in recurring workflow execution rather than external glue code.
